metrics.profile_summary: Versatile professional with over 14 years of experience across operations, business development, and corporate training. Holds an MBA/M.Phil in Marketing and possesses strong skills in stakeholder management and strategic partnerships.

education.institution: Government College of Technology, S.I.T.E, Karachi

experience.description: Manages corporate partnerships and revenue generation, securing PKR 20M+ annually. Scaled training capacity by 59% and diversified recruitment through online and offline marketing channels.
Optimized fleet management and resource allocation. Managed vendor relations and implemented data-driven cost reduction strategies.
Administered student lifecycle management and drafted university policies to streamline administrative processes.
Developed technical curricula for AutoCAD and PTC Creo. Mentored students and aligned training content with industry market needs.
Coordinated faculty activities and managed student support services.
Supervised plant operations and enforced ISO quality control protocols to optimize production efficiency.

strengths: Strong business development and partnership track record
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
weaknesses: Lacks direct experience managing consumer brand marketing budgets
No mentioned proficiency in GA4 or specific ad platform reporting
Professional experience is primarily in TVET/Education/Operations rather than integrated marketing management
No evidence of managing external creative agencies
evaluation.summary: While the candidate has the required academic background in Marketing and strong general management skills, he lacks the specific professional experience of running integrated consumer campaigns and the mandatory technical proficiency in GA4 and ad platform reporting.
